title: 42: NASA Goddard's Spacecraft Simulator
description: 42 is NASA Goddard's open-source simulator for spacecraft attitude and orbit dynamics: it propagates position, velocity, attitude, and angular rates for one or many spacecraft in multi-body gravity. Named for the answer to everything, it answers dynamics questions with high fidelity. It is a workhorse for GNC development and analysis.
provenance: Public record: compiled from official project documentation and published specifications. Fact-checked 2026-10-21.

title: Attitude: Quaternions
description: 42 represents attitude with quaternions — four numbers with no singularities, unlike Euler angles that blow up at 90 degrees pitch. Quaternion kinematics propagate cleanly, and every sensor and actuator model speaks the same language. GNC engineers think in quaternions or they suffer.
provenance: Public record: compiled from official project documentation and published specifications. Fact-checked 2026-10-21.

title: Orbit: Two-Body Plus Perturbations
description: 42 propagates orbits in multi-body gravity with perturbations — J2 oblateness, drag, solar pressure — layered on the two-body core. The orbit and attitude couple through gravity-gradient torque and aerodynamic torque. One sim, both dynamics, consistently.
provenance: Public record: compiled from official project documentation and published specifications. Fact-checked 2026-10-21.

title: Reaction Wheels
description: Reaction wheels trade angular momentum with the spacecraft body: spin the wheel one way, the bus rotates the other. 42 models wheel inertia, friction, saturation, and momentum dumping. Wheels are the precision actuators of modern spacecraft — silent, smooth, and saturable.
provenance: Public record: compiled from official project documentation and published specifications. Fact-checked 2026-10-21.

title: Thrusters and Torque Rods
description: 42 models thrusters (force + torque, with misalignment and minimum impulse) and magnetic torque rods (dipole vs Earth's field) — the coarse actuators for momentum dumping and safe modes. Wheels do the fine work; thrusters and torquers handle the big jobs and the emergencies.
provenance: Public record: compiled from official project documentation and published specifications. Fact-checked 2026-10-21.

title: Star Trackers and Sun Sensors
description: 42 simulates the sensors GNC flies on: star trackers (arcsecond attitude from star fields), sun sensors (coarse sun direction), magnetometers, and gyros with bias and noise. Sensor models include dropouts and errors so the navigation filters prove themselves against reality.
provenance: Public record: compiled from official project documentation and published specifications. Fact-checked 2026-10-21.

title: GPS and Orbit Determination
description: 42 models GPS-style navigation: pseudorange measurements from the constellation geometry dilute into position fixes with realistic error. Combined with propagator truth, engineers tune orbit determination filters. Knowing where you are is the prerequisite for everything else.
provenance: Public record: compiled from official project documentation and published specifications. Fact-checked 2026-10-21.

title: Multi-Spacecraft Scenarios
description: 42 simulates formations and constellations — relative dynamics, cross-links, collision screening — in one run. Formation flying (like MMS's tetrahedron) needs relative navigation and coordinated control, all developed in multi-spacecraft sim. One executive, many vehicles.
provenance: Public record: compiled from official project documentation and published specifications. Fact-checked 2026-10-21.

title: Flexible Bodies and Slosh
description: Real spacecraft bend and slosh: 42-class analysis adds flexible appendages (solar arrays) and fuel slosh modes that couple with attitude control. A controller that ignores flexibility can go unstable on orbit. High-fidelity sim includes the wobble.
provenance: Public record: compiled from official project documentation and published specifications. Fact-checked 2026-10-21.

title: Disturbance Torques
description: 42 accounts for the torques that fight the controller: gravity gradient, aerodynamic, solar pressure, and magnetic residuals. Sizing actuators starts with sizing disturbances. The quietest spacecraft still lives in a noisy torque environment.
provenance: Public record: compiled from official project documentation and published specifications. Fact-checked 2026-10-21.

title: Safe Modes
description: When faults strike, 42-tested safe modes take over: sun-pointing power-positive attitudes with minimal actuator needs, waiting for ground rescue. Safe mode is the spacecraft's survival instinct, and it is proven in sim long before it is needed. Every mission has one.
provenance: Public record: compiled from official project documentation and published specifications. Fact-checked 2026-10-21.

title: Monte Carlo with 42
description: 42 runs Monte Carlo dispersions on dynamics: mass properties, sensor errors, actuator misalignments, initial conditions. Pointing budgets and propellant margins come out as statistics. The sim fleet proves the design across the uncertainty cloud.
provenance: Public record: compiled from official project documentation and published specifications. Fact-checked 2026-10-21.

title: 42 and Formation Missions
description: MMS flies four spacecraft in a tetrahedron through Earth's magnetosphere — the formation design, relative navigation, and station-keeping all developed in 42-class simulation. Multi-spacecraft sim is mission-enabling for formations. 42 answers 'where is everyone' precisely.
provenance: Public record: compiled from official project documentation and published specifications. Fact-checked 2026-10-21.

title: Truth Models vs Filter Models
description: 42 embodies a core sim discipline: truth models (high fidelity, what really happens) vs filter models (what the flight software believes). The gap between them is where navigation is proven. Simulating both at once is how GNC earns flight rationale.
provenance: Public record: compiled from official project documentation and published specifications. Fact-checked 2026-10-21.

title: The Full 42 Workflow
description: Ladder-top 42: build the spacecraft (mass, actuators, sensors), set the orbit, close the GNC loop, disperse with Monte Carlo, and prove pointing and margins. Fifteen rungs from quaternions to flown formations.
provenance: Public record: compiled from official project documentation and published specifications. Fact-checked 2026-10-21.
